core_gap.title: No normative requirements for PQC certificate rotation coordination in multi-tenant PKI

evidence.quote: ACME allows domain name owners to automate the process of obtaining a certificate from a CA.
evidence.relevance: ACME defines single-entity certificate automation. No multi-tenant coordination requirements are defined.
ZTA per-tenant policy isolation is a stated goal; no PKI rotation coordination model exists for multi-tenant environments.
